prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Terbium (터븀) itself — the sovereign of the Terbium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: about twenty — a fresh young-adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a striking androgynous handsomeness; deep brown skin; softly tapered face narrowing to a small, soft chin; medium-sized eyes — long monolid eyes, level outer eye corners; low heavy brows; broad soft nose; soft medium lips; yellow-green chartreuse eyes; a small beauty mark beside the lips.
Body and hair: willowy and long-limbed with soft curves — a full bust, rounded hips and a slender waist build; long wavy hair with wispy see-through bangs; dark umber hair whose ends glow a brilliant yellow-green like a lamp phosphor.
Expression: attentive, steady eyes, mouth closed.
Her element, carried in her design: terbium: a soft silvery-grey metal named in 1843 for a piece of the name of Ytterby, a Swedish quarry village, a name later swapped by mistake with erbium's; its ions glow a brilliant yellow-green under ultraviolet light or electron beams, the green of three-band fluorescent lamps beside europium's red and of X-ray screens; alloyed with iron and dysprosium as Terfenol-D it stretches and shrinks in a magnetic field so strongly that it drives underwater sonar and turns a table or a window into a speaker.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. Slate-grey and phosphor-green light armor with ring-shaped armor bands floating free around her waist and ankles that ripple like sound waves, each ring edged with brilliant yellow-green light, a small iron-grey resonator disc at the chest, thin red and blue accent lights flanking the green; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown.
Silhouette: ring-shaped armor bands floating free around her waist and ankles, with light body armor — the floating rings make the shape. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette.
Colours: brilliant phosphor yellow-green, slate iron grey, dark umber, tricolour red and blue accents.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2200, a city that sings: glass towers whose whole facades tremble as speakers, a plaza lit by three-band light where the yellow-green glows brightest between red and blue, gates of sound rings rippling outward like waves on water.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Tb) and atomic number (65) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish.
